title: An $h$-adaptive Tetrahedral Spectral Element Method with Applications to Kohn-Sham Density Functional Theory
summary: High-order $h$-adaptive spectral element methods on tetrahedral meshes provide an effective framework for resolving localized singularities and multiscale structures in complex three-dimensional geometries. However, their development is often hindered by difficulties in maintaining $C^0$ continuity across refinement interfaces and efficiently transferring solutions between adaptive meshes.
